title: Validate one local Space destination and dispatch one exact Item assignment

requirements.invariant: One assignment uses stable Item and destination Space identity. The Item has at most one current Space; assigning a new destination replaces the old placement, while clearing remains a separate operation.

The assignment destination comes from an operation-specific local directory in the exact Account and Project-or-Business-Inventory scope. It resolves by stable SpaceID and supplies the exact Space revision; names, route state, Account-wide arrays and backend paths cannot identify or authorize the destination.

A represented active destination may be selected from ready, partial or stale cached evidence for offline conflict detection; local evidence never grants authorization, and an absent row in incomplete evidence cannot prove that the destination does not exist.

One nonempty single-or-bulk assignment carries exact Item revisions and validates every Item and destination Space in the same Project or Business Inventory scope; the authoritative handler later applies the complete selection atomically and idempotently. This application boundary cannot define physical persistence or trusted authorization.

Assignment changes organizational placement only. It submits no attachment or marker list and changes no Transaction, occurrence, Invoice, budget contribution, payer, price or other accounting/provenance state; archive, media and scope-changing movement remain separate.

ItemSpaceAssignmentIntent is transient and non-Codable with exactly AccountID, ItemPlacementScope, destination SpaceID and typed Item/revision candidates. It adds no copied Space revision, Item-selection read model, display name, route, backend path, UI state, provider identity or authorization claim.

The use case validates exact Account/scope and represented destination evidence, derives ExpectedSpaceRevision from that row, constructs the verified ItemSpaceAssignmentDraft and AssignItemsToSpaceCommand before one ItemSpaceAssigning call, validates the receipt afterward, preserves exact LocalOperationState, pre-port application failures, operation failures and CancellationError, and maps every other port error to ItemSpaceAssignmentFailure.localAcceptanceFailed.

The verified assignment operation remains sole owner of canonical nonempty Item/revision input, exact destination/scope/revision preconditions, deterministic ordering, operation envelope, subject, fingerprint, receipt validation and all 16 ItemSpaceAssignmentFailure values. This use case composes rather than reimplements or extends them.

requirements.section: Enhanced Pilot Review and Implemented Contract
requirements.invariant: The verified destination-read contract remains sole owner of validated Account/scope request, active stable Space ID/name/revision rows, deterministic order, local completeness/quality, and bounded malformed/rebound refusal. This use case resolves one exact represented row and adds no directory read, filter, sort or eligibility policy.

Only the two new target leaves advance. The verified assignment-operation and destination-read leaves stay verified; SpacePickerList, InventoryItemsSubTab, TransactionDetailView, SpaceDetailView, AddExistingItemsPicker, NewItemView, SharedItemsList and ItemsService retain their prior status and content because each owns broader UI, read, service or source behavior.

Exactly two target-only executable leaves may change after READY. Physical persistence, optimistic placement or marker projection, trusted authorization/audit/apply, Postgres/Data API/RLS/PowerSync/provider behavior, app/MCP wiring, source migration, hosted resources, production, release and cutover do not advance.

items: ItemSpaceAssignmentUseCaseFailure has exactly directoryAccountMismatch, directoryScopeMismatch and destinationNotRepresented with diagnostic codes item_space_assignment_directory_account_mismatch, item_space_assignment_directory_scope_mismatch and item_space_assignment_destination_not_represented; not represented describes only supplied evidence.
ItemSpaceAssignmentIntent is a public transient non-Codable four-field value over exact Account, placement scope, destination Space and typed Item/revision candidates.

The use case reuses the verified destination directory, ItemSpaceAssignmentDraft, AssignItemsToSpaceCommand and ItemSpaceAssigning port; it derives the Space revision from the exact row and invokes the port once only after every evidence/construction check.

Receipt validation follows the port boundary; pre-port application failures, port operation failures and Swift cancellation remain exact, while every other port error—including an impossible port-originated ItemSpaceAssignmentUseCaseFailure—is bounded to localAcceptanceFailed.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: No Item, Space, placement, operation, marker, accounting, table, view, function, constraint, index or migration change.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No trusted membership/scope/revision validation, authorization, marker closure, idempotency store, audit assignment, physical placement or authoritative transaction exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No Data API relation, function or grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed local intent and represented directory evidence are not authorization; no Account/Project/Inventory/Item/Space policy or role behavior is implemented.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Item/Space/operation table, upload connector, optimistic placement or synchronized visibility exists.

localOffline.notApplicable: The use case is network-independent behind a port and may consume represented ready/partial/stale evidence, but adds no physical intent/operation persistence, process/device restart write, optimistic row/marker, retry policy or rejection recovery.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Assignment submits no attachment, locator, URL, bytes or marker list and defines no marker closure, upload, cache, retention or deletion behavior; O-023 remains outside.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Item-selection read model, Set Space picker, loading/empty/error/control behavior, SwiftUI composition, app route, MCP schema/tool/resource or transport is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No source Item.spaceId, Space DTO, AccountContext array, independent bulk write, route, marker, export row or source-to-target mapping is decoded or transformed.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Only bounded contract failures are values; no telemetry, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook is added.

items: Implementation may change only the two provider-free target leaves; all named dependencies and source UI/service/model/provider surfaces remain unchanged.

The deterministic in-memory assigner cannot physically persist, authorize, synchronize, move scope, close markers, mutate accounting/provenance, deploy, display, migrate, release or cut over an assignment.
O-007/O-015/O-023/O-037 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain open or outside because accounting/provenance, media/archive, provider and production behavior are excluded.

verification.expected: A non-@testable consumer constructs the exact public four-field ItemSpaceAssignmentIntent. It is compile-time Equatable/Sendable, runtime non-Codable, preserves Project and Business Inventory scope plus boundary Item revisions, and exposes no Space revision, name, route, provider, media or accounting field.

An exact represented active Space dispatches once from ready, partial and stale validated directories for Project and Business Inventory. Only its row supplies ExpectedSpaceRevision; zero/UInt64.max Space and Item revisions remain exact, and differently ordered equivalent Item input reaches one canonical command.

Directory Account/scope mismatch, absent destination row in ready-complete or incomplete partial/stale evidence, empty/duplicate Item input and positive infinity/negative infinity/NaN capture time all fail before any call. Missing-row failure is exactly destinationNotRepresented and never an authoritative-nonexistence assertion.

Every LocalOperationState returns in the exact validated receipt after exactly one call carrying the verified assignment payload and preconditions; a mismatched receipt fails after exactly one call without any placement/accounting claim.

A reciprocal flattened encoded-leaf matrix independently varies Account, Project-versus-Inventory scope, destination SpaceID, directory-owned Space revision, each Item ID/revision, Operation, actor, contract and time against literal baseline and changed-leaf expectations. Test helpers must not reconstruct expectations through production draft/command validation.

All three ItemSpaceAssignmentUseCaseFailure values arise exactly before the port with zero calls. All 16 ItemSpaceAssignmentFailure values deliberately thrown after one port call remain exact, CancellationError remains structured cancellation, and arbitrary or impossible port-originated application failures map to localAcceptanceFailed.

All three use-case and 16 operation diagnostics remain exact stable enumerations and reveal no synthetic identity, display name, raw error, source path, credential, provider payload or production identifier.

Exact intent and nested command topology expose only the authorized assignment draft/envelope/subject/fingerprint plus destination/Item scope/revision preconditions—never a copied Space revision in intent, clear/archive/media/marker/scope-movement/accounting/provenance/UI/service/provider/credential/production field.
